plan.title: Verify environment and package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Install/pin ultralytics==8.1.0 if needed. Verify GPU availability and VRAM.
plan.success_criteria: All critical packages at correct versions, GPU confirmed available with VRAM reported

plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Load data/train/annotations.json, count images, annotations, categories. Compute stats: annotations per image (min/max/mean), category frequency distribution, image dimensions. Check data/products/ structure (how many products have reference images, how many images per product). Examine metadata.json.
plan.success_criteria: Full understanding of data: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, reference image availability logged

plan.title: Analyze category distribution and few-shot categories
plan.description: Plot/log category frequency histogram. Count how many categories have 1, 2, 3-5, 5-10, 10-50, 50+ annotations. Identify the 'unknown_product' category (356). Check which categories have reference product images available.
plan.success_criteria: Clear picture of class imbalance and reference image coverage

plan.title: Explore store sections and image metadata
plan.description: Check if annotations.json or image filenames contain store section info (Egg, Frokost, Knekkebrod, Varmedrikker). Determine how to stratify the split by section.
plan.success_criteria: Know how to identify store sections for stratified splitting

plan.title: Create 90/10 stratified train/val split
plan.description: Write a script to split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json (COCO format). 90% train (~223 images), 10% val (~25 images). Stratify by store section if identifiable. Use seed=42. All annotations for an image stay together.
plan.success_criteria: Two valid COCO JSON files created, proportional section representation in val, reproducible with seed=42

plan.title: Write evaluation function
plan.description: Implement evaluation using pycocotools COCOeval. Compute detection_mAP@0.5 (all predictions mapped to single category) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original category_ids). Return val_score = 0.7 * det_mAP + 0.3 * cls_mAP. Test with dummy predictions to verify it works.
plan.success_criteria: Function returns correct val_score, tested with dummy data

plan.title: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format
plan.description: Write converter from COCO JSON to YOLO txt format (one txt per image with class x_center y_center width height normalized). Create dataset YAML for ultralytics. Handle the train/val split.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO-format dataset ready for training with correct paths and class count

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8n at 640 resolution with 357 classes establishes a baseline val_score
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n with nc=357, imgsz=640, ~100 epochs, batch=16. Use ultralytics==8.1.0. Evaluate on val split using the evaluation function. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP, training time.
plan.success_criteria: Baseline val_score recorded, model trains without errors

plan.title: YOLOv8s nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves over YOLOv8n due to more capacity for 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with same settings as baseline. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over YOLOv8n

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m further improves with more capacity
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m, nc=357, imgsz=640, ~150 epochs. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to previous best

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l provides better accuracy for dense multi-class detection
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l, nc=357, imgsz=640, ~150 epochs. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to previous best

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x is the largest YOLO model and may provide the best accuracy
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x, nc=357, imgsz=640, ~150 epochs. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to previous best, note training time and model size

plan.title: Best YOLO model at 1280 resolution
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution (1280) significantly improves detection of small products on dense shelves
plan.description: Take the best performing YOLO size from steps 8-12, retrain at imgsz=1280. Adjust batch size to fit GPU memory. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Significant val_score improvement from higher resolution

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 (detection-only) at 1280
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection recall since it doesn't need to distinguish 357 classes
plan.description: Convert all annotations to category 0. Train YOLOv8x nc=1 at imgsz=1280. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. Compare detection performance to nc=357 model.
plan.success_criteria: Higher detection_mAP than nc=357 model

plan.title: Longer training with best model size and resolution
plan.hypothesis: 357 categories with augmentation need more epochs to converge
plan.description: Train best model config for 300-500 epochs with patience=100, close_mosaic=50. Compare val_score to shorter training.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement or confirmation of convergence point

plan.title: Explore DINOv2 embeddings for classification
plan.description: Load DINOv2-base (from torch.hub or timm). Extract embeddings for: (1) reference product images from data/products/, (2) cropped training annotations. Measure embedding quality: compute nearest-neighbor accuracy on training crops using reference gallery.
plan.success_criteria: DINOv2 embeddings extracted, NN accuracy on training crops measured

plan.title: Build DINOv2 classification pipeline
plan.description: Create a two-stage pipeline: (1) YOLO detects boxes, (2) crop each detection from original full-res image, (3) embed with DINOv2, (4) kNN lookup against gallery of reference + training crop embeddings. Return category_id from nearest neighbor.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end, produces predictions in COCO format

plan.title: Evaluate YOLO detection + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 kNN classification on YOLO crops improves classification_mAP over YOLO's own class predictions
plan.description: Run the two-stage pipeline on val split. Compare val_score to YOLO-only predictions. Use nc=1 YOLO boxes + DINOv2 classification, and nc=357 YOLO boxes + DINOv2 classification.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from DINOv2 classification

plan.title: kNN hyperparameter tuning for DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k and distance weighting improve classification accuracy
plan.description: Sweep k={1,3,5,7,11}, distance metrics (cosine, L2), and temperature for softmax weighting. Evaluate classification_mAP on val split for each setting.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN configuration identified, val_score recorded

plan.title: Gallery composition experiment
plan.hypothesis: The mix of reference images and training crops in the gallery affects classification quality
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (a) reference images only, (b) training crops only, (c) both with equal weight, (d) training crops weighted 2x, (e) reference main/front images repeated 3x. Measure classification_mAP for each.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces better embeddings for fine-grained product distinction
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large, rebuild gallery, run classification pipeline on val split. Compare classification_mAP to DINOv2-base. Note model size for budget planning.
plan.success_criteria: Quantified improvement from DINOv2-large, size/speed tradeoff documented

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Default NMS IoU=0.7 and conf=0.25 are suboptimal for dense shelf detection
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8} and confidence threshold {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3} on val split. Find optimal combination.
plan.success_criteria: Best NMS/conf thresholds identified, val_score improvement documented

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA (multi-scale + flip) improves detection mAP by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run inference with augment=True on val split. Measure val_score improvement and inference time increase.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement quantified, inference time within budget

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference dramatically improves detection of small products that are missed at 1280 resize
plan.description: Implement sliced inference: split each image into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles (stride ~960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with WBF/NMS. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Significant detection_mAP improvement, inference time within 300s budget

plan.title: RT-DETR-l baseline
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR (transformer-based) has different error profile from YOLO, useful for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=357 at imgsz=640 and 1280. Evaluate standalone val_score. Note model size and inference speed.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR val_score recorded, comparison to YOLO documented

plan.title: RT-DETR-x training
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-x may outperform RT-DETR-l with more capacity
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-x at best resolution. Compare to RT-DETR-l and best YOLO.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to all previous models

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling architecturally diverse models (YOLO + RT-DETR) improves detection by 2-4 mAP
plan.description: Run both best YOLO and best RT-DETR on val images. Merge predictions using Weighted Boxes Fusion (ensemble-boxes). Tune WBF IoU threshold and weights. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: WBF ensemble: multiple YOLO scales
plan.hypothesis: Combining YOLO at different resolutions (640 + 1280) catches different scale products
plan.description: Run best YOLO at 640 and 1280, merge with WBF. Compare to single-resolution and YOLO+RT-DETR ensemble.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to other ensemble configurations

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO + DINOv2 fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification
plan.description: For each detection, compare YOLO class confidence vs DINOv2 embedding similarity. Use YOLO class if confidence > threshold, else DINOv2. Sweep threshold on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over either method alone

plan.title: Fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: A learned projection head on frozen DINOv2 features better separates visually similar products
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2, train a 2-layer MLP with ArcFace or contrastive loss on training crops + reference images. Use the projected embeddings for kNN classification. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement over raw DINOv2 embeddings

plan.title: Training hyperparameter tuning: augmentation and regularization
plan.hypothesis: Tuning augmentation strength and regularization improves generalization on small dataset
plan.description: Experiment with: mosaic probability, mixup, copy-paste augmentation, label_smoothing=0.1, close_mosaic timing (50 vs 100 vs 150 epochs before end). Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Best hyperparameter configuration identified

plan.title: Progressive resizing training
plan.hypothesis: Training at 640 first then fine-tuning at 1280 is faster and may generalize better
plan.description: Train best model at 640 for 100 epochs, then resume at 1280 for remaining epochs. Compare val_score and total training time to direct 1280 training.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparable or better, training time reduced

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Pasting reference product photos onto shelf backgrounds creates useful synthetic training data for rare categories
plan.description: For categories with <5 training annotations, paste reference product images onto random shelf backgrounds with perspective warps and lighting adjustments. Retrain with augmented dataset.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement for rare categories

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations reduces sensitivity to exact box boundaries
plan.description: For each detection, extract 3-4 crops (original, center zoom 80%, padded 120%, slight shift). Average DINOv2 embeddings before gallery lookup. Evaluate classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement over single-crop

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching individual DINOv2 patch tokens is more robust to occlusion than global embedding
plan.description: Instead of CLS token, use all patch tokens from DINOv2. Compute patch-level similarity between query crop and gallery entries. Evaluate classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement over CLS-token-only approach

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Products on the same shelf section tend to be from the same category group; co-occurrence priors improve classification
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data. For each test image, use detected high-confidence products to bias classification of uncertain detections toward co-occurring categories.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement on val split

plan.title: Per-category adaptive thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Some products are easy to classify (unique packaging) while others are near-impossible; adaptive thresholds improve overall score
plan.description: For each category, learn an optimal confidence threshold from val split. Only assign that category if confidence exceeds threshold; otherwise fall back to category_id=0 or next-best category.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from adaptive thresholds

plan.title: YOLO training at 1600 or 1920 resolution
plan.hypothesis: Even higher resolution preserves more product detail for dense shelves
plan.description: Train best YOLO model at imgsz=1600 or 1920. Reduce batch size, use gradient accumulation. Compare val_score to 1280.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement justifies slower training/inference

plan.title: Rectangular inference (rect=True)
plan.hypothesis: Preserving aspect ratio during inference helps on non-square shelf images
plan.description: Run inference with rect=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP to square inference.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement documented

plan.title: Image preprocessing: CLAHE contrast enhancement
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detect products in poorly lit shelf areas
plan.description: Apply CLAHE preprocessing to val images before detection. Compare detection_mAP to unprocessed images.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement or confirmation that preprocessing doesn't help

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling for gallery augmentation
plan.hypothesis: High-confidence detections on val/test images can augment the DINOv2 gallery for better classification
plan.description: First pass: run full pipeline on val images. Second pass: add high-confidence crops (score > 0.85) to gallery, re-classify uncertain detections. Measure classification_mAP improvement.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement from pseudo-labeling

plan.title: Model quantization: YOLO FP16 export
plan.hypothesis: FP16 YOLO model maintains accuracy while halving size
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX FP16. Verify accuracy matches FP32 on val split. Measure model size and inference speed.
plan.success_criteria: Accuracy maintained within 0.5 mAP, model size halved

plan.title: Model quantization: YOLO INT8 export
plan.hypothesis: INT8 quantization significantly reduces model size with minimal accuracy loss
plan.description: Export YOLO to INT8 ONNX. Benchmark accuracy vs FP16 on val split. Measure size savings.
plan.success_criteria: Accuracy loss < 1 mAP, significant size reduction

plan.title: DINOv2 ONNX export and optimization
plan.hypothesis: ONNX DINOv2 runs faster than PyTorch for inference
plan.description: Export DINOv2 to ONNX (opset ≤ 20). Benchmark inference speed vs PyTorch. Verify embedding quality is preserved.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX model works correctly, speed improvement documented

plan.title: Tiled inference + TTA combination
plan.hypothesis: Combining tiled inference with TTA maximizes detection recall
plan.description: Run tiled inference with TTA on each tile. Merge all predictions with WBF. Measure val_score and total inference time.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement, inference time within 300s budget

plan.title: Ensemble: YOLO tiled + YOLO full-image + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Three-model ensemble with different scales and architectures maximizes detection
plan.description: Combine predictions from: (1) YOLO with tiled inference, (2) YOLO on full image at 1280, (3) RT-DETR at 1280. Merge with WBF. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Best ensemble val_score achieved

plan.title: Class-balanced sampling / focal loss for rare categories
plan.hypothesis: Oversampling rare categories or using focal loss improves classification of few-shot classes
plan.description: Implement image-level oversampling for images containing rare categories (< 5 annotations). Alternatively, increase focal loss gamma. Retrain and compare classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improvement for rare categories

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Manually verified annotations (corrected=True) are higher quality; weighting them improves training
plan.description: Check if annotations have a 'corrected' field. If so, duplicate corrected annotations or weight their loss higher. Retrain and compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from annotation weighting

plan.title: Build complete inference pipeline for submission
plan.description: Create run.py that: loads YOLO model, runs detection (with tiling/TTA if beneficial), crops detections, runs DINOv2 classification, applies confidence gating, outputs predictions.json. Ensure it works within sandbox constraints (no blocked imports, pathlib instead of os).
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct predictions.json format, runs without blocked imports

plan.title: Inference time profiling on simulated L4 constraints
plan.hypothesis: The full pipeline runs within 300s for all test images
plan.description: Profile inference time per image for the full pipeline. Estimate total time for ~50-100 test images on L4 GPU. Identify bottlenecks and optimize if needed.
plan.success_criteria: Estimated total inference time < 300s

plan.title: Optimize inference speed: batch DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: Batching DINOv2 crop embeddings is faster than one-by-one
plan.description: Collect all detection crops, batch them (e.g., batch_size=64), run DINOv2 in batches. Measure speedup.
plan.success_criteria: Significant inference speedup documented

plan.title: Smaller YOLO + more tiles tradeoff
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with more tiles might beat YOLOv8x with fewer tiles within the same time budget
plan.description: Compare: (a) YOLOv8x at 1280 full image, (b) YOLOv8m with 4 tiles at 1280, (c) YOLOv8s with 9 tiles at 1280. Same total inference time budget. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Best speed/accuracy tradeoff identified for tiling

plan.title: Embedding-weighted box fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding agreement as additional signal during box fusion improves ensemble quality
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from different models, compute DINOv2 embedding similarity. Upweight boxes that agree on embedding. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over standard WBF

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs WBF vs standard NMS comparison
plan.hypothesis: Different fusion methods have different strengths for dense shelf detection
plan.description: Compare NMS, Soft-NMS, and WBF for single-model and multi-model scenarios on val split. Tune parameters for each.
plan.success_criteria: Best fusion method identified for each scenario

plan.title: DINOv2-small as lightweight alternative
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-small may be sufficient for classification while freeing weight budget for ensemble detectors
plan.description: Test DINOv2-small classification quality. If acceptable, use saved budget for a second detector model.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP tradeoff documented, budget analysis updated

plan.title: Two-detector ensemble + DINOv2 within 420MB budget
plan.hypothesis: Two detectors ensembled + DINOv2 classification beats single detector + DINOv2
plan.description: Find a combination of two detector models + DINOv2 that fits in 420MB. E.g., YOLOv8l INT8 (~45MB) + RT-DETR-l FP16 (~130MB) + DINOv2-base FP16 (~170MB) = ~345MB. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble within budget, val_score improvement over single detector

plan.title: Final model selection and configuration
plan.description: Compare all experiment results. Select the configuration with highest val_score that fits within submission constraints (420MB weights, 300s inference, sandbox-compatible). Document the final config.
plan.success_criteria: Best configuration selected with documented val_score

plan.title: Package submission: export models and create run.py
plan.description: Export all models to ONNX or .pt format. Create final run.py with all inference logic. Create gallery .npy file. Verify total size < 420MB. Test run.py end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: Submission package complete, all files < 420MB, run.py works correctly

plan.title: End-to-end validation of submission package
plan.hypothesis: The packaged submission produces the same val_score as during development
plan.description: Run the exact submission run.py on val images. Verify predictions.json format. Compute val_score and confirm it matches development results.
plan.success_criteria: val_score matches development, predictions.json format correct

plan.title: Document best configuration for human operator
plan.description: Write a summary of: best model configuration, training commands for full dataset retraining, all hyperparameters, val_score achieved, and any notes about the submission.
plan.success_criteria: Clear documentation for human to retrain on full 248 images
